glyhub

glyhub aims to provide a curated collection of glycomics and glycoproteomics datasets from the literature and public databases. The planned collection will store datasets as GlycomicSE and GlycoproteomicSE objects from glyexp, bringing measurements, molecular annotations, and sample metadata together in a consistent format.

Development status

glyhub is currently a package skeleton. It does not yet include curated datasets or data-access functions. Dataset examples will be added when the first resources are available.

The initial design is to bundle curated datasets with the package and make them available through R’s LazyData mechanism. This is a planned architecture; datasets, the dependency on glyexp, and lazy loading have not yet been implemented.

Installation

You can install the development skeleton from GitHub:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("glycoverse/glyhub")

Installing the current skeleton does not provide any datasets.

Role in glycoverse

The intended role of glyhub is to collect and curate reusable experimental data for the Glycoverse ecosystem. glyexp provides the GlycomicSE and GlycoproteomicSE containers; glyhub is planned to supply curated datasets stored in those containers for examples, method development, and reproducible analyses.
